revisionDesc.change: Vote - AcceptText - paraphe not in the SB edition. See Sampson's comments.

Vote - AcceptText - The stauros in the upper margin needs to be encoded with 1,msup.; the paraphe is (I presume) the traces below συμβολαιογράφου, in which case encode using (9, indent). Is a PN correction called for, in this case, or is the paraphe in the print edition? I agree with the two stauroi in line 8.

Submit - I added two crosses missing in editio priceps (on the upper margin and on the line 8, after the hypographe). I added alco a cross at the beginning of completio - present in the edition but missig in the papyri.info. I added a line 9 with paraphe.

Commit - I added two crosses missing in editio priceps (on the upper margin and on the line 8, after the hypographe). I added alco a cross at the beginning of completio - present in the edition but missig in the papyri.info. I added a line 9 with paraphe.
